title: T. Rex Won't Stop
subtitle: Is your little drummer knocking?
style: flat hand-drawn illustration on speckled cream paper with tiny grey flecks, the speckled paper fills the whole square picture edge to edge with no border, simple flat colour shapes with thin wobbly outlines, muted faded colours: rusty red, soft pink, pale yellow, soft green and grey-blue, ordinary objects drawn plain, without eyes or faces, the upper third of the picture left as empty speckled paper, no words, no letters and no writing anywhere in the picture

pages.zh:
嘿，小朋友。
你知道霸王龙最讨厌什么吗？
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing on a lawn looking at the viewer, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Hey, kid.
Do you know what T. rex hates most?

pages.zh:
不是下雨。
它站在雨里，
一动不动。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing in the rain, completely unbothered, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Not rain.
It stands in the rain
and doesn't even move.

pages.zh:
不是蚊子。
蚊子停在它鼻子上，
它交了个新朋友。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face with one tiny mosquito sitting on its nose, completely unbothered, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Not mosquitoes.
A mosquito lands on its nose,
and it makes a new friend.

pages.zh:
也不是洗头。
它把泡泡顶在头上，
当帽子。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face with a big pile of shampoo foam on its head, completely unbothered, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Not even hair washing.
It wears the bubbles on its head
like a hat.

pages.zh:
是——
停下来。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face frozen mid-step on one foot with its tiny arms flung out, as if someone pressed pause, a plain face, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
It's—
stopping.

pages.zh:
它一玩起来，
就停不下来。
跑步，停不下来。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face running fast across a meadow, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Once it starts playing,
it can't stop.
Running? Can't stop.

pages.zh:
捉迷藏，
停不下来。
躲着躲着，就忘了自己在躲。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face hiding badly behind a very thin tree, almost all of its body showing, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Hide-and-seek?
Can't stop.
It hides so long, it forgets it's hiding.

pages.zh:
搭石头城堡，
从早上搭到天黑，
还停不下来。
月亮说：「我都困了。」
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face still stacking stones into a tall stone castle late in the evening, a small crescent moon and a few stars drawn on the speckled paper above, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Building a rock castle?
From morning till dark,
and it still can't stop.
The moon says, “Even I'm sleepy.”

pages.zh:
可是，有一件事，
它不停也得停。
它的肚子，开始说话了。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face stopping suddenly and looking down at its own round belly, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
But there is one thing
that makes it stop, no matter what.
Its tummy starts talking.

pages.zh:
每只恐龙的肚子里，
都住着一个小鼓手。
你的肚子里，也有一个。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face looking down in surprise at one small toy drum sitting on its round belly
pages.en:
Inside every dinosaur's tummy
lives a little drummer.
There's one in your tummy too.

pages.zh:
咚咚咚。
这是在说：
该去厕所了。
pages.scene: A small wooden outhouse standing behind a big tree in a meadow, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
Boom, boom, boom.
That means:
time to go to the bathroom.

pages.zh:
三角龙一听见，
马上就去。
它说：「回来再玩，也一样。」
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face walking briskly towards a small wooden outhouse
pages.en:
When Triceratops hears it,
it goes right away.
It says, “I'll play when I get back.
Same fun.”

pages.zh:
长脖子恐龙的肚子
离脑袋太远了。
咚咚咚要走好久，
才传到脑袋。
pages.scene: One very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur with a tiny head, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing alone with one small toy drum drawn on its round belly, a row of little wavy lines travelling slowly up its very long neck towards its tiny head, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
The long-neck's tummy
is very far from its head.
Boom, boom, boom takes a long, long time
to get all the way up there.

pages.zh:
所以，它总是
天还没亮就出发。
pages.scene: One very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur with a tiny head, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face setting off towards a small wooden outhouse at dawn, a few stars still in the sky
pages.en:
So it always
sets off before the sun comes up.

pages.zh:
剑龙最麻烦。
背上的板子，
会卡在门框上。
pages.scene: One pink stegosaurus with wobbly plates along its back, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face stuck in the doorway of a small wooden outhouse, the plates on its back jammed against the door frame
pages.en:
Stegosaurus has the hardest time.
The plates on its back
get stuck in the door frame.

pages.zh:
不过，有一件事，
你一定、一定要记住：
千万别让小鼓手等。
pages.scene: One small toy drum sitting alone on a tree stump in a meadow, nothing else in the picture
pages.en:
But there is one thing
you must never, ever forget:
never keep the little drummer waiting.

pages.zh:
你不理它，
它就越敲越响。
咚咚咚，变成轰轰轰。
pages.scene: One small toy drum shaking hard on a tree stump, leaves falling off the trees around it
pages.en:
If you ignore it,
it drums louder and louder.
Boom, boom, boom turns into BOOM, BOOM, BOOM.

pages.zh:
敲到最后，
它累了，不敲了。
这可不是好事。
pages.scene: A silent small toy drum on a tree stump, and beside it one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face looking surprised
pages.en:
In the end,
it gets tired and stops drumming.
That is not a good thing.

pages.zh:
那天，你和霸王龙
比赛搭石头塔。
谁搭得高，谁就赢。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts stacking stones into a tower on the grass next to one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face, who builds its own tower
pages.en:
That day, you and T. rex
have a rock-tower contest.
Whoever builds higher wins.

pages.zh:
咚咚咚。
霸王龙说：「等一下，我再玩一会儿。」
小鼓手说：「好吧。」
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face waving one tiny arm dismissively while stacking stones, a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts watching
pages.en:
Boom, boom, boom.
T. rex says, “Wait. Let me play a little longer.”
The little drummer says, “Okay.”

pages.zh:
咚咚咚咚！
「再等一下，我快赢了！」
小鼓手说：「我数到三。」
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face stacking stones with its knees pressed tightly together, a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts looking worried
pages.en:
Boom, boom, boom, boom!
“Wait a little more, I'm almost winning!”
The little drummer says, “I'm counting to three.”

pages.zh:
咚咚咚咚咚！
「再……再等一下……」
你指着远处：「厕所在那边！」
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face sitting beside a tall stack of flat round pebbles, drops of sweat flying off its head, its knees pressed together, a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts standing next to it and pointing far away towards a distant green hill with one tiny wooden outhouse on top
pages.en:
Boom, boom, boom, boom, boom!
“Just… just a little more…”
You point far away: “The bathroom's over there!”

pages.zh: 轰！轰！轰！
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face jumping straight up into the air with its eyes squeezed shut and both tiny arms clutching its round belly, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en: BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!

pages.zh:
霸王龙夹着腿，
就跑。
厕所比赢重要。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face hurrying along with tiny quick steps, its knees pressed tightly together and both tiny arms holding its round belly, eyes wide, mouth closed in a small worried line, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
T. rex squeezes its knees together
and runs.
The bathroom is more important than winning.

pages.zh: 厕所在山那边！
pages.scene: A wide green hill with one tiny wooden outhouse far away on the other side, one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face small in the front
pages.en: The bathroom is on the other side of the hill!

pages.zh: 要过一条小河。
pages.scene: One big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face leaping over a small stream, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en: Across a little river.

pages.zh: 要跳过三块石头。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts running ahead and pointing the way while one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face hops across three stepping stones
pages.en: Over three stepping stones.

pages.zh:
还要钻过一个山洞。
你在前面帮它开路。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts holding branches aside at the mouth of a cave while one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face hurries through
pages.en:
And through a cave.
You run ahead to clear the way.

pages.zh:
差一点点……差一点点……
门口那位，还没挪开！
pages.scene: One pink stegosaurus with wobbly plates along its back, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face still stuck in the doorway of a small wooden outhouse, and one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face hopping from foot to foot beside it
pages.en:
Almost there… almost there…
The one in the doorway still hasn't moved!

pages.zh:
剑龙挪开了。
扑通！坐上去了。
霸王龙说：「好险。」
pages.scene: A small wooden outhouse with its door closed, the head of one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face poking up through a hole in its roof, eyes closed, smiling with relief, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Stegosaurus squeezes out.
Plop! T. rex sits down.
T. rex says, “That was close.”

pages.zh:
回来一看，石头塔还在，
一块都没倒。
「原来一听见就去，
一点都不耽误玩。」
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts and one big friendly green T. rex, soft and rounded with no sharp teeth, a big round head, tiny arms, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face standing beside two tall stone towers, both smiling
pages.en:
When they come back, the rock towers are still there.
Not one rock has fallen.
“So if you go right away,
you don't miss any playing at all.”

pages.zh:
现在你知道了：
小鼓手一敲，马上就去，
游戏会等你。
对了，你的小鼓手，
现在敲门了吗？
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts walking towards a bathroom door holding a toy dinosaur, looking back over his shoulder at the viewer, no real dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
Now you know:
when your little drummer drums, go right away.
The game will wait for you.
By the way—
is your little drummer knocking right now?
